title: free-bible contribution: verse references for an article or book
description: Contract between the frontend (bible.flogvit.com) and free-bible for crowd-submitted metadata linking articles/books to Bible verses (issues #15/#16). FLOW: (1) frontend collects a submission matching this schema and stores it as review.status='pending' in its own DB; (2) every online submission is human-reviewed before acceptance — nothing enters free-bible unreviewed; (3) approved submissions are exported to free-bible as curated data keyed by target id. THE KVN RULE: the CONTRIBUTOR only supplies 'raw' (the reference exactly as written) + 'context_translation' (which translation it is from) — they never need to know what KVN is. Versification differs between translations (Psalm titles, Hebrew chapter shifts), so raw text without translation context is ambiguous; WITH it, resolution is deterministic and happens on OUR side later (pipeline: parseRef() + refsToKvn(), cross-mapped through kvn/mappings/<translation>.ukvn.json to osmain; verified by the reviewer). The frontend MAY resolve eagerly and show the verse text for the contributor to confirm (nice UX + quality signal, sets resolved_by='frontend'), but this is optional. A submission can only be APPROVED once kvnFrom/kvnTo are filled in and verified.

kind.description: What the target is. Same refs model for both.

target.description: Identification of the article/book. Give the strongest identifier you have; free-text fallback forces the reviewer to resolve or create a catalog entry.

catalog_id.description: free-bible article catalog id (DOI with / -> _, lowercased), e.g. '10.4102_hts.v57i3_4.1889'. Strongest for articles.

url.description: Where the contributor found the work.

freetext.description: Fallback when no identifier is known — reviewer must resolve before approval.

refs.description: The verse references this work discusses/cites.

raw.description: EXACTLY what the contributor typed or found, never normalized away — e.g. '1. Mos 4,5' or 'Ps 51:3 (MT 51:5)'.

context_translation.description: Module id of the translation the reference is from (e.g. 'osnb', 'osnn', 'osen', 'oses', 'dnb2011', 'wlc'), i.e. the versification context 'raw' is expressed in. REQUIRED — without it a reference like 'Salme 51,3' is ambiguous. This is the ONLY thing beyond the reference itself the contributor must supply.

kvnFrom.description: Canonical KVN of the first verse. MUST be the number produced by the kvn library (kvn/src/kvn.ts parseRef() -> refsToKvn(), i.e. encode() from kvn/src/types.ts — e.g. Esra 3:1 = 15740944). NOT the ukvn mapping-internal encoding (ukvnEncode has different multipliers — easy to confuse). Resolved through context_translation's ukvn mapping to osmain versification first when the translation diverges. NOT expected from the contributor — filled in later by our pipeline/reviewer; REQUIRED before approval.

kvnTo.description: Canonical KVN of the last verse in the range; equal to kvnFrom for a single verse.

kvnRef.description: Human-readable canonical form in osmain terms, e.g. '1 Mos 4:5' — display/debug aid, kvnFrom/kvnTo are authoritative.

resolved_by.description: Who resolved raw -> KVN: 'frontend' (eager, contributor confirmed), 'pipeline' (our batch parseRef pass), 'reviewer' (manual).

confirmed_by_contributor.description: true if the frontend showed the resolved verse text and the contributor confirmed it — strong quality signal for review.

kind.description: cites = explicit reference; discusses = substantive treatment; covers_passage = the work/chapter is about this passage (commentaries).

where.description: Optional locator inside the work — enables deep links (url_pdf#page=N) and makes review much faster.

quote.description: Short quote for the reviewer to verify against. Kept internal — never published (copyright).

comment.description: Free text from the contributor to the reviewer.

by.description: Contributor identity — used for attribution of approved contributions (opt-in) and abuse handling. Keep PII in the frontend DB; only 'name' (display name) travels into free-bible on export, and only when credit=true.

review.description: Moderation state machine: pending -> approved | rejected | needs_info (-> pending again after contributor responds). Approval REQUIRES: target resolved to a concrete id, and every ref carrying verified kvnFrom/kvnTo.
